Project: Smart Farm Advisory And Agricultural Products Management System (APMS) For South Sudan

- Backend: Django (Python) with Django REST Framework
- Frontend: React, Bootstrap, CSS
- Database: SQLite (dev), PostgreSQL (prod)
- API: OpenWeather API integration
- Hosting: Heroku
- Folder structure: backend/, frontend/, docs/, infra/
- README.md and .gitignore required in root

Follow best practices for Django, React, REST API, and Heroku deployment. Use modular, scalable, and maintainable code.
